claims.statement: OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest by default in the shipping app.

claims.statement: Public beta installers are signed, macOS is notarized, and clean-machine OS trust checks pass.
claims.scope: Every artifact named in the beta platform support matrix, built from the release tag.
claims.limitation: CI explicitly disables automatic signing, final-DMG notarization is not wired, protected publisher pins are not wired, and no tagged run has produced notarization or signature evidence. The canonical verifier can evaluate macOS and Windows observations, bind them to exact current-attempt desktop upload jobs and artifact ID/digest outputs, and reject carried-forward partial-rerun evidence, but intentionally refuses Linux until package-format methods and pinned trust roots exist. GitHub's artifact API remains run-wide and exposes no native artifact-to-job or artifact-to-attempt relation; its timestamps are quantized to whole seconds, so the accepted artifact-creation interval is inclusively bounded by upload-step start and producer-job completion rather than upload-step completion. The gated tag workflow therefore refuses draft creation.
